{{Top|leg}}
A '''hover-flare''' was an incendiary device used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Launched to a pre-determined altitude, the flare would ignite before hovering in place for a brief time, showering their enemies in a brilliant light. The CIS made widespread use of hover-flares, which provided additional light for [[Droid Army|droid-based armies]] to see by, in addition to revealing hiding weaponry used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].
